semantic.justification: Task64 extends the existing shared reserved-slot adapter with erased native ValueT copy/move construction, in-place assignment, destruction, optional operator== and move-if-noexcept traits. All existing initialized vector helpers and std_vector operations preserve object ownership; copy/move constructor and assignment, rvalue append and destructor bindings reuse the same storage. Native selected libc++ whole streams compare object identities, values, capacities and every special-member event for both move traits, aliased append, all insertion branches, retained/reallocated assignment, empty operations and self copy/move. Borrowed scalar/pointer stores remain shared. This is language infrastructure, not a new mdds container or certified whole STL implementation. Custom allocators, throwing operator cleanup, invalid/self-inserting ranges, other standard-library implementations, physical ABI and complete mdds/Calc cell/document/UI remain unverified.
